purpose: First bounded follow-up after the public leaderboard feedback; six fixed SVM configurations

inner_cv.feature_refit: independent within each training fold; cached only across C values in that fold

within_representation_selection: highest mean training-only CV AUROC; exact ties prefer smaller fold SD, then C=1, C=0.1, C=10
finalist_evaluation: one selected C per representation; fit complete calibrated pipelines on 8000 rows, then evaluate both on the fixed 2000 development rows
between_finalists_selection: highest validation AUROC among export-eligible finalists, else highest validation AUROC for reporting only; exact ties prefer higher CV mean, lower CV SD, then c60
quote_rule: U+2018/2019/201A/201B -> ASCII apostrophe; U+201C/201D/201E/201F -> ASCII double quote

export_rule.guardrail_note: The subgroup/format margins are predeclared practical safeguards, not statistical equivalence thresholds. A positive conditional interval is not proof of hidden-test improvement.

stopping_rule: Complete six CV configurations, evaluate exactly two finalists, verify artifacts, and export at most one eligible full-label candidate. Do not expand the grid at its boundaries or automatically start another method family.
limitations: This follow-up was motivated by two public scores; it is a new development study, not a retroactive change to Q5.
The fixed validation set has already been inspected; paired intervals omit training variation and selection adjustment.
Typography sensitivity is not an established simulation of hidden domain/generator shift.
No actual Kaggle upload or private-score claim is authorized by this runner.
